title: Hotels with a Sagrada Família view: which room to book
metaDescription: Three Barcelona hotels with Sagrada Família view rooms, the exact room category to book, and the courtyard, terrace and city rooms that don't come with it.
h1: Hotels with a Sagrada Família view, and which room to book
dek: Three Barcelona hotels near the Sagrada Família. For each one we list the exact room category sold with the view, and the courtyard, terrace and city rooms to skip.
teaser: Few rooms see the church, and some hotels named after it only see it from the roof.

decoder.text: At the Sercotel Rosellón the Classic Double is sold two ways. Only the one with the view in its name is for the church. The Basic rooms look onto an inner courtyard.

decoder.right: Double or Twin Sagrada Familia View
decoder.text: At the Eurostars Monumental a terrace is not the view. Hotels.com lists one Double Room, Terrace with a city view, and the church only in the two categories that name it.
The Hotel Sagrada Familia on Carrer de Còrsega sells Single, Double, Triple and Superior rooms, none with a view named. The hotel puts the church behind its rooftop terrace.

book.note: No category here is sold with the church in the name. What to Do in Barcelona says the Junior Suites on the upper level see it from the balcony, and a Hotels.com guest review mentions a view of the Sagrada Família for the suites. Ask which floor you will get.

alternatives.title: No view room? Try a rooftop
alternatives.text: The Hotel Sagrada Familia says its rooftop terrace has the Sagrada Família as a backdrop. What to Do in Barcelona says the same of the Radisson Blu 1882 and adds that neither hotel's bedrooms have the view.

faq.q: Which Barcelona hotels sell rooms with a Sagrada Família view?
faq.a: Of the hotels we checked in October 2026: Sercotel Rosellón and Eurostars Monumental sell categories with the Sagrada Familia in the name. The Boutique Hostemplo Sagrada Familia sells no such category, but a guide says its upper-level Junior Suites see the church from the balcony.

faq.q: Does a hotel with “Sagrada Familia” in its name have the view?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The Hotel Sagrada Familia on Carrer de Còrsega sells Single, Double, Triple and Superior rooms with no view named, and shows the church from its rooftop terrace.

faq.q: Which hotels see the church only from the roof?
faq.a: The Hotel Sagrada Familia and the Radisson Blu 1882. What to Do in Barcelona says their bedrooms don't have the view and the rooftop terraces do.

faq.q: Is the Eurostars Monumental next to the church?
faq.a: No. Barcelona Turisme puts it about 400 m away, and Forever Barcelona says you cross the Diagonal to reach the church.
